proposals.name: Grand Island Township Proposal to Renew Township Operating Tax Levy
proposals.description:
Shall the Grand Island Township operating millage approved by the voters in
2022 be renewed at the same rate of up to 2.0000 mill ($2.00 per $1,000 of taxable value), and be levied for four (4) years (2027-2030) inclusive, for general operating purposes?
If approved and levied in full, this millage will raise an estimated additional $13,104.00 for general Township operating purposes in the first calendar year of the levy based on state taxable valuation.
proposals.ballotLanguage:
Shall the Grand Island Township operating millage approved by the voters in
2022 be renewed at the same rate of up to 2.0000 mill ($2.00 per $1,000 of taxable value), and be levied for four (4) years (2027-2030) inclusive, for general operating purposes?
If approved and levied in full, this millage will raise an estimated additional $13,104.00 for general Township operating purposes in the first calendar year of the levy based on state taxable valuation.
proposals.officialTitle: GRAND ISLAND TOWNSHIP PROPOSAL TO RENEW TOWNSHIP OPERATING TAX LEVY
proposals.yesVote: A YES vote continues the existing levy of 2 mills for 4 years — generally no increase over what you pay now, plus the restored or added amount described.
proposals.noVote: A NO vote lets the current millage expire; the service it funds would need cuts or other revenue.
proposals.conservativeView: Renewals are the least disruptive way to keep a service funded, but every renewal is a chance to ask whether the service is delivering value. Watch for "renewal" proposals that quietly restore Headlee rollbacks — that is a tax increase.
proposals.progressiveView: Keeps an existing, voter-approved service funded at the same rate with no new tax.
